# Draft:Precision agriculture

Introduction
Agroz Inc. is a Malaysia-based agricultural technology company specializing in controlled environment agriculture (CEA), vertical farming, and AI-powered farm automation. The company develops modular indoor and outdoor farming systems designed to increase crop yield, reduce water use, and provide consistent year-round production. Agroz operates through its Malaysian subsidiary Agroz Group Sdn Bhd and is listed on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol AGRZ. History
Background
Agroz was founded in Malaysia with the objective of applying data systems, automation, and controlled-environment design to improve food production efficiency in Southeast Asia. The company initially focused on small-scale vertical farming units before expanding into commercial-scale modular systems. In subsequent years, Agroz began developing an integrated farm operating system combining sensors, automation software, and data analytics to optimize growing conditions. The company’s technology development included partnerships with robotics and automation firms to incorporate AI-driven monitoring and autonomous task execution within its farm modules.
Agroz later expanded its footprint through indoor vertical farms and distribution partnerships with retailers in Malaysia. The company debuted on the Nasdaq exchange in 2025. Technology and Operations
Agroz designs and manufactures modular vertical farming units capable of deployment in both indoor and semi-outdoor environments. These systems use controlled lighting, nutrient delivery, climate management, and environmental sensors to maintain optimal growing conditions. The company’s platform includes:
● Agroz Farm Operating System, which integrates sensor data, crop monitoring, and automation workflows.
● Modular grow panels, designed for scalability across urban or commercial settings.
● AI-enabled control and optimization, intended to reduce labor dependency and increase production efficiency.
Agroz has also explored robotics integration for tasks such as harvesting, plant movement, and environmental inspection. Partnerships and Collaborations
Agroz has entered strategic collaborations with technology and automation companies to support robotics, artificial intelligence, and controlled-environment research. The company has also partnered with retailers and distribution chains to supply vertically-farmed produce across selected Malaysian outlets.
Agroz’s product offerings include:
● Vertical farm modules for commercial deployment
● Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) systems
● Farm automation software and sensors
● Fresh produce supplied to retailers and foodservice operators
Market and Business Model
Agroz operates within the broader AgTech and CEA sectors, targeting commercial growers, retailers, and organizations seeking sustainable food-production solutions. Its revenue streams include farm system sales, agricultural produce distribution, and technology licensing.
Recognition
Agroz has been featured in regional media for its contributions to agricultural innovation, sustainability, and urban farming. The company has participated in technology exhibitions, industry conferences, and innovation showcases related to AgTech and controlled environment agriculture.
